website = env.ref('real_estate.website_industry')
to_deactivate = [ # Presets 'website_sale.carousel_product_indicators_left', 'website_sale.cta_separator', 'website_sale.products_shop_title', 'website.header_text_element', 'website_sale_comparison.product_add_to_compare', # Default static pages 'website.homepage', 'website.contactus', ]
to_activate = [ # Presets 'website_sale.carousel_product_indicators_bottom', 'website_sale.filmstrip_categories_pills', 'website_sale.header_hide_empty_cart_link', 'website.footer_custom', 'website.header_call_to_action', 'website.template_header_default_align_right', 'website_sale_comparison.accordion_specs_item', ]
ctx = {'website_id': website.id}
# website_sale_comparison is auto-installed rather than a declared dependency: # skip silently the views of a module that is not present. for xml_id in to_deactivate: view = env.ref(xml_id, raise_if_not_found=False) if view: view.with_context(**ctx).write({'active': False}) for xml_id in to_activate: view = env.ref(xml_id, raise_if_not_found=False) if view: view.with_context(**ctx).write({'active': True})
menus = env['website.menu'] base_domain = [('website_id', '=', website.id)]
# Default menu items to remove: website_appointment is auto-installed and adds # an Appointment menu to every new website. menus.search(base_domain + [('url', 'in', ['/appointment'])]).unlink() # Rename /shop menu to "Properties" menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', '/shop')], limit=1).write({'name': 'Properties'}) # Add Matchmaking then Contact us after Home (10) and Properties (/shop, 20). # Core's default menu is Home only, so /contactus needs its own entry even though # the page itself is created later, in demo/website/pages/contactus.xml. top_menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('parent_id', '=', False)], limit=1) for name, url, sequence in [('Matchmaking', '/match', 30), ('Contact us', '/contactus', 40)]: if not menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', url)]): menus.create({ 'name': name, 'url': url, 'sequence': sequence, 'website_id': website.id, 'parent_id': top_menu.id if top_menu else False, })
